tbl_description: Working table: one row per physical water filter (parentEventID grain): position, depth, collection datetime, ship, cruise and grid keys. Projected into core `sample` (sample_type filter).
Working table: one row per occurrence (one ASV in one sequencing library): taxon, read count and the library's assay (dloop or 12s).
Working table: one row per filter x taxon x assay, reads summed over ASVs and PCR replicate libraries. Projected into core `obs` as edna_reads_<assay> and, collapsed over assays, edna_presence.

Working table: one row per filter x measurement_type: co-collected nutrients, chl_fluor, dissolved oxygen (mg/L), DNA concentration and the per-assay raw and filtered read totals. Projected into core `sample_measurement`. The FAIRe protocol-text measurementTypes and the 'OTUs or ASVs assigned to taxa' values are not published (question Q04).
